==Biography==
Calvin "'''k1ng'''" Truong joined [[Dire Wolves]] in August 2014, under the name '''BEST AD'''. Soon after joining the team, he was moved to a substitute position due to being underage and replaced by [[ChuffeR]] for the [[2014 Oceanic Regional Tournament/Grand Finals|Oceanic Regional Finals]]. In November, BEST AD returned to the starting lineup and ChuffeR moved to support.

In January 2015, BEST AD renamed to '''k1ng'''. Dire Wolves placed second in the [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 1 Playoffs|first split OPL playoffs]] and then tied for third with [[Avant Garde]] in the [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 2 Playoffs|second split playoffs]].  At the end of the season k1ng left the team and joined [[Legacy eSports]], temporarily renaming to '''yb''' but shortly after returning to '''k1ng''' as his handle.
